page.layout: One printed page (right page of the scan) with running head at top, page number at top right, one text column with a centred numerical diagram in the middle, and a catchword at the foot. Left edge shows part of the facing page with margin notes (left-hand fragments, not transcribed as they belong to the other page and are cut off).

main_text.p: 2. Sint uero uiginti quatuor aurei ita partiendi, ut quoties primus tres, toties secundus 4, & quoties hic duos, toties tertius 3: itemq; quoties tertius 6, toties quartus unum auferat. Quæ cuiusq; portio erit?

Hic trium rationum termini scilicet, 3 4, 2 3. 6 1, in terminos quatuor, datas rationes continuè amplectentes, sunt reducendi, idq; per posterius Theorema, scilicet in 3.4.6.1. Totus ex additis primus proportionis terminus erit, ijdemq; sigillatim positi, tertius, numerus diuidendus intermedius, tumq; proportio sic concludetur:

3. Quatuor alij 120 aureos communi cōsortio lucratos, sic partiri debent, ut quoties secundus <, toties tertius 9: & quoties tertius 7, toties quartus 11: & quoties quartus 9, toties primus 13 habeat. Quæ igitur hic cuiusque portio?
Quæstio speciem habet nonnihil diuersam, sed tractatio est eadem. Ex datarum enim rationum continuè minimis

page.notes: Fragments of the facing left page (margin words such as "ata-", "ro-", "ex-", "onne", "in u", "Sint") are cut off and not transcribed. Fractions in the diagram are rendered approximately as printed; the numerals in the table of ratios are small and some are uncertain. The line "L 3." at the foot is a signature mark: "L 3 ." followed by the catchword "minimis".
